paper_title: Solar neutrino limit on axions and keV-mass bosons
notes: Limit from Eq. (4) derived using SNO all-flavor solar neutrino flux measurements and self-consistent solar models with axion Primakoff losses. The constraint is based on requiring solar energy loss La < 0.1 L⊙ to maintain agreement with measured neutrino fluxes. Applies to sub-keV mass particles (solar core temperature ~1 keV). Flat limit across ~1 μeV to 1 eV mass range. Somewhat more restrictive than helioseismological limit but less restrictive than CAST for ma < 0.2 eV. Confidence level 95% inferred from comparison to CAST limits cited at 95% CL.
